name: Calendar Event Reminder
description: Email template for reminding students and staff about upcoming calendar events
subject: Reminder: {event_name} - {event_date}
body_html:
📅 Event Reminder

Dear {recipient_name},

This is a reminder about an upcoming {event_type}:

Event: {event_name}

Date: {event_date}

Type: {event_type}

{description}

Please mark your calendar and prepare accordingly.

Best regards,
Academic Calendar System

event_type.description: Type of event (e.g., exam, holiday, deadline)

description.description: Description or additional details about the event
